saying: Why harden your hearts as the Egyptians and Pharaoh hardened theirs?
source: Drawn from the BSB, STEPBible TAHOT and TAGNT, and the commentaries named under each note.

layers.evidence: Rests on the Philistine priests' advice about returning the ark.
layers.text: The Philistine priests warn their leaders not to be stubborn as Pharaoh was. When God struck Egypt, the Egyptians finally let Israel go, so the Philistines should send the ark back.

layers.evidence: Keil and Delitzsch note that the verb here (hit'allel) is used as in Exodus 10:2. Gill says the priests are referring to the ten plagues God sent on Egypt.
layers.text: The priests describe the Exodus in the language of Exodus itself. Their verb for how God afflicted Egypt (hit'allel) is the one God used in Exodus 10:2, how severely I dealt with the Egyptians. Even Israel's enemies remembered what God did to Pharaoh.
